hypotheses.statement: At Q=4096 dispersed, B5S has higher landscape-level FSCAUC than B5R without violating the HV guardrail.
hypotheses.falsifier: The 95% cluster-bootstrap CI lower bound for B5S-B5R FSCAUC is <=0.01, Holm q>=0.05, or the HV CI lower bound is <-0.005.

hypotheses.statement: At Q=4096 dispersed, B5S has higher landscape-level FSCAUC than B1 without violating the HV guardrail.
hypotheses.falsifier: The 95% cluster-bootstrap CI lower bound for B5S-B1 FSCAUC is <=0.01, Holm q>=0.05, or the HV CI lower bound is <-0.005.

hypotheses.statement: The B5S-B5R FSCAUC gain is larger at Q=4096 than at Q=16.
hypotheses.falsifier: The 95% cluster-bootstrap CI lower bound for the Q4096-minus-Q16 interaction is <=0.01 or Holm q>=0.05.

hypotheses.statement: At the Q=2 harm-detection boundary, B5S does not breach the -0.005 terminal normalized feasible-HV guardrail relative to B5R or B1.
hypotheses.falsifier: Either B5S-minus-baseline landscape-bootstrap HV CI upper bound is <-0.005; a CI spanning -0.005 is inconclusive rather than evidence of equivalence.

baselines.name: B5R
baselines.fairness: ok: identical evaluator, initial population, schedule seeds, DE parameters, injection count, selected rows, NFE and selection; only state targeting changes from least-visited to uniform random.

baselines.name: B1
baselines.fairness: ok: identical evaluator, paired seeds, NFE, population, archive and DE parameters; no tuning budget, with absence of novelty injection declared as the treatment difference.
